It provides a detailed, formulaic word-by-word exposition of the *Puṇṇakamāṇavapucchā* preserved in the Pārāyanavagga of the Sutta Nipāta (Snp 5.4) [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral records two modern translations of the work across two languages [SuttaCentral].

The text also shares thematic links or citations with numerous discourses across the canon, including the Dīgha Nikāya (DN 33, DN 34), the Saṃyutta Nikāya (SN 7.9, SN 20.1, SN 45.139), the Aṅguttara Nikāya (AN 3.32, AN 3.111, AN 4.41, AN 9.29–30, AN 10.79–80), and Abhidhamma treatises such as the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī* (Ds 2.3.2) and *Vibhaṅga* (Vb 17) [SuttaCentral].
